■ Stage Direction
SE: Cheering

What I strive for together with Seeking the Pearl.
It is—not merely reaching the peak of the world.

Even if you fall behind at the start, as long as you have a challenging spirit,
you can catch up and turn the tables. That's the hope I want to show them.

Indeed. Relying solely on raw talent might make you strong.
At least enough to achieve... what that old lady entrusted to me.

I wanted to anticipate every possibility and test them all.
So that no matter when or what happens, we will never lose hope.
Which will it be, this "gold pearl" or the "silver pearl"?

Tell me, aren't you thinking to yourself right now...
"I've found the ultimate pearl"?

There's a pearl capable of turning even yesterday's defeat into new possibilities!
I've already memorized your rhythm! Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

Seeking the Pearl, who leaped sideways right at the start of the mock race.
Perhaps she finally opened up to me—because she at last revealed the reason.

It went without saying. Hearing that answer,
Seeking the Pearl gave a mischievous grin, and then—

Come, let me hear your order.
What is the destination that will make your life shine—

Truly, a world-class pearl.
Yet I refuse to compete solely on the sparkle of natural-born talent.

If she wasn't temperamental and had a clear reason for her erratic moves...
then Seeking the Pearl is a flawless, top-tier Umamusume.

I should scout her after all.
I'm going to go and...

Fufu, gooood! Nice shopping!
Now then, let us officially make this a partnership.

Even without being so cautious,
it seems fully possible for her to keep racking up victories, but...
It was me. I am the one who found a pearl in you.

People like us can't make our dreams come true even if we have them. That's why
I want a girl with a real chance like you to do her best. For our sake, too.

For the first time, I understood the brilliance Seeking the Pearl was chasing.
It wasn't a victory just for herself—
H-Hey, where are you going?! Hey!

Fufufu, wonderful, simply wonderful, Taiki...!
Running like that rain or shine. In a mile race, you truly are the strongest. But!

Through my running, the lands of the world will become one!
All six continents! All the islands! A rainbow of possibility will span across them!

First, allow me to show you my current possibilities.
Just how much the present me can achieve.

Fufu, but unfortunately, that is incorrect.
You didn't find the pearl. The one who found it—

Next, it's your turn to show me, Trainer!
What kind of dream do you envision for me?

I glance briefly at the accessories placed on the counter...
but the answer—naturally, is already set.

"Drawing the outermost gate," "a late break," "getting bumped off course."
Anything can happen. That is why—

Oho-ho-ho-ho♪ Beyond the realm of possibility!
Beautifuuul!!!!

Gooood! No, that is perfect, Trainer!
Then—

Fufu, it's already decided, isn't it?
And that is—

To "banish the despair" of all the people across the globe
who couldn't dare to dream, whom I have seen with my very own eyes!

And even the 'haves' will lose to those who have more.
Yet having everything decided by what you're born with is not fabulous in the slightest.

Work hard so you can live in a place like this in the future, okay?
I'm sure you can do it, little lady.

Of course not... I live in a tiny rented room in the back alleys.
That's just how tourist towns are.

After her convincing win, Seeking the Pearl vanished—
as if shaking off the flood of Trainers rushing toward her.

(Conditions are never the same. In this world, you never know
what might happen. And out there in the world—)

An accessory shop, obviously. My daddy is a jeweler.
Introducing top-of-the-line jewelry is the family trade, after all.
—Possibility. Did you just say possibility?

Or those born in countries without industries, who were blessed with talent
but never even given the chance to put it to use.

It was entrusted to me, but... the goal I embraced was different.
It wasn't to succeed just to live in a grand mansion.
...It seems that leaping sideways was entirely intentional.
Tell me, Grandma, do you live in a house like this right now?

H-Hey, Seeking the Pearl really is something else!
I thought she'd be hard to handle, but that blowout today...!

In a race, you can be hit with all kinds of disadvantages.
For instance—

The one and only pearl capable of making me shine—
out in this vast world, that is.

Here, little Umamusume, take a look.
This is the royal palace.
However, there is—a continuation to that story.

Yes, this world is—a handicap match.
A cruel race where the 'haves' win, and the 'have-nots' lose.

Bringing hope to people all around the world. What was truly world-class
wasn't just her talent—it was the magnitude of what she sought beyond victory.
Now then, I have shown you my world map.

Guhhh, Pearl-san?! You are completely different from last time?!
This speed...!!

Hey, Trainer over there. How about some accessories?
Fufufu...♪
(WOOOOOOOHHHH!!)

It wasn't just that old lady. In the backstreets behind the skyscrapers
built by oil money, countless people were struggling to breathe.

The world is vast. So vast that words of encouragement cannot reach across it. Yet
there is a single thing capable of transcending language barriers. And that is—

This is—the reason I don't rely solely on talent.
The reason I dare to challenge the impossible. —Understand?

If footage of me overcoming every hardship to claim victory is broadcast,
it will become a universal message.

—A race. Simply running, competing, and aiming for victory.
There is no country anywhere that does not know this primal sport.

—Some time later.
At the summer festival grounds.

And now—the rematch with Taiki Shuttle.
Turf, 1200m, Sunny, Firm.
